entry.title: dotnet/roslyn - Issues & Pull Requests - 2026-11-22
entry.content:
Issues

Created

  • Union case types not checked for accessibility consistency #86583
  • Incremental parsing reports CS1513 at a stale position after reusing a node #86581
  • Incremental parsing drops lexical diagnostics from an interpolated string that becomes skipped text #86577
  • Incremental Script parse throws `InvalidCastException` in `GetDiagnostics` and `Emit` for valid source #86575
  • IDE0370 reports `field!` in a property getter as unnecessary, but removing it causes CS9264 #86573
  • IDE0340 "Use unbound generic type" breaks the build when nameof goes through a member typed by a type parameter #86572
  • Semantic snippet formatting broke #86571

Closed

  • is { } is constant-folded for union structs while is not null matches the underlying union value #86567
